_description: An agent that can load sessions (session/load), for the idle stop. A prompt with 'polish' edits the abstract of main.tex and answers; any other prompt just answers. Loading a session replays a conversation (a user message, a thought, a plan, an edit tool call and an answer, all marked REPLAYED) before the agent answers, as Claude's adapter does: the client must show none of it again.
